verses.gurmukhi: ੯ : ਰਸੀਆਂ ਨੇ ਗੵਾਨੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਦੇਣਾ ਤੇ ਗੵਾਨੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਨਾਂਹ
verses.translit_en: 9 : raseeaa(n) ne gayeaaneeaa(n) noo(n) dhenaa te gayeaaneeaa(n) dhee naa(n)h

en.bdb: The devout offer joy to the vain scholars but they do not accept it

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਹੈ ਝਰੋਖੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਖਿੜਕੀ ਖੋਲੑਹਿ ਦੀਵਾਨ ਲਗਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: bahai jharokhe paatisaeh khiRakee khol(h)h dheevaan lagaavai|

en.bdb: The emperor (Lord) sitting in a window (holy congregation) gives audience to the people in a arranged court.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਚਉਕੀ ਮਹਲ ਦੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮਰਦਾਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਆਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: a(n)dhar chaukee mahal dhee baahar maradhaanaa mil aavai|

en.bdb: Inside gather the privileged persons but outside assemble the commoners.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੀਐ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਖਾਸਾਂ ਮਹਲਿ ਪਿਲਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: peeaai piaalaa paatisaahu a(n)dhar khaasaa(n) mahal pilaavai|

en.bdb: The Emperor (Lord) Himself quaffes the cup (of love) and arranges to serve the select ones inside.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਨ ਅਮਲੀ ਸੂਫ਼ੀਆਂ ਅਵਲ ਦੋਮ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਲਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: dhevan amalee soopheeaa(n) aval dhom dhekh dhikhalaavai|

en.bdb: Keeping in view the two categories of the likely addicts and the teetotallers (so-called religious persons) He Himself distributes the wine of love to them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰੇ ਮਨਾਹ ਸਰਾਬ ਦੀ ਪੀਐ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਹੋਰੁ ਸੁਖਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: kare manaeh saraab dhee peeaai aap na hor sukhaavai|

en.bdb: The teetotaller (engaged in ritualism) neither drinks the wine of love himself nor allows others to drink.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਲਸ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਮਿਹਰ ਕਰਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: aulas piaalaa mihar kar virale dhei na pachhotaavai|

en.bdb: Getting pleased, that Lord goes on giving the cup of His grace to the rare ones and never regrets.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਹੁ ਨ ਵਸਾਵੈ ਕਿਹੈ ਦਾ ਗੁਨਹ ਕਰਾਇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬਖਸਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: kih na vasaavai kihai dhaa guneh karai hukam bakhasaavai|

en.bdb: None is to blame, lie himself makes the creatures commit crime and himself pardons their sins in the hukam, the divine will.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਨਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪ ਕੈ ਜਿਸੈ ਜਣਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: hor naa jaanai piram ras jaanai aap kai jisai janaavai|

en.bdb: None else understands the mystery of the delight of His love; only He himself knows or the one whom He makes to know.
Any rare gurmukh beholds the glimpse of that imperceptible Lord.
